item.title: Creating and using Postgres MCP with Codex
item.description: How I gave Codex direct access to a Postgres database through an MCP server, so it can check the schema, run queries and confirm migrations instead of guessing from source files. Covers installing it, checking it's registered, starting it and turning it off.

item.title: Running Stable Diffusion Locally on Fedora 43 with no GPU
item.description: You can generate AI images locally on a Fedora 43 laptop with no GPU. I used stable-diffusion.cpp and a simple browser UI on my Framework, and these are the exact steps that worked.
